name: offer-desk.learning-read
purpose: Read Offer Desk usage attempt outcomes from the declared memory scope and report whether the cohort is comparable, preserving an empty scope as a real reading.

operation.description: Restrict the read to one operation, for example board-read. Omitted reads every operation in the scope.

assumptions: vrooli-memory owns attempt validity; this program copies its verdict and never recomputes it.
The offer-desk-usage scope is registered before this program is called.
invariants: An empty scope is reported as zero eligible attempts with comparable false; it is never reported as a measured result.
Reliability and truncation are copied from the producer verbatim.

signals.eligible_attempts: Attempts the producer considered eligible in the window.
signals.cohorts: Up to twelve comparison cohorts as the producer returned them.
signals.comparable: True only when the producer called the sample reliable, it was not truncated, and at least one attempt is eligible.
signals.comparability_reason: Why the cohort is not comparable; null when it is.

fixtures.note: A newly registered scope returns zero eligible attempts and comparable false; that is ok, not partial.
